Benchtop Fifty

Benchtop Fifty

Fifty open-source hardware projects, each taken from a one-paragraph brief to a package you could build from: exact parts, a checked circuit, a wiring plan, an illustrated guide and a case to print.

Every package was designed unattended by Claude Opus 5.5 using the Benchtop skill. They are drawings, not products: none has been built yet.

No project matches. Clear the search or pick another category.

Each package starts from an established open-source project, named and linked on its sheet. The firmware you flash is that project's own; the package adds the concrete build around it.

Sizes come from part files that mostly describe common clone boards. Check the real parts against the guide's inventory page and the fit sheet before soldering or printing. Prices are estimates or listings seen on 14 November 2026.
